Delhi High Court Declines Urgent Hearing on DU Hostel Plea

The Delhi High Court has refused to grant an urgent hearing to a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) seeking the construction of more hostels for Delhi University (DU) colleges. The plea was mentioned before a bench comprising Chief Justice DK Upadhyaya and Justice Tejas Karia. The court questioned the urgency, with one judge remarking that the lawyer was wasting their own time. The PIL was filed in the context of a recent building collapse incident, though the coverage does not specify the nature of the collapse or its direct link to the hostel plea.
